resolved_findings: Require baseline and receipt filenames to match their expected collector kinds.
Require baseline and receipt run_id and slot to match before either export write.
Label baseline event-file references as later same-run companion evidence.
Eventless captures explicitly say events.jsonl is absent and establish no native turn; capture-status.json is suggested only when present.
independent_review.scope: Read-only final helper, sixteen tests, nine ignore entries, six concrete exports and retained-source bindings, including the zero-event note correction; no live operations.

limits: This verdict covers publication derivatives and their bounded evidence preservation, not a new native enforcement acceptance.
Original broad-source hashes are locally verified; repository readers receive scoped derivatives and can reproduce the four-outcome analysis with the existing public event and SEL evidence.
Final deck, model council and later artifact changes require their own exact-candidate receipts.
No Git staging, commit, push, AWS, SSH, policy or native UI action was performed by this publication task.

minimization.baseline_companion_scope: Baseline event links explicitly identify later same-run companions, not baseline-time evidence.
minimization.omitted: Broad SEL pages, authentication fingerprint details, unrelated audit traces and full conversation snapshots. Exact-run audit evidence, scoped companion event hashes and aggregate SEL counts remain.

offline_reproduction.method: Copy the publication receipt to receipt.json and scoped events to events.jsonl in a fresh temporary run directory; invoke the unchanged CLI with --sel-receipt and the existing SEL since/until window. No --collect-sel or live configuration is used.
offline_reproduction.note_delta_effect: Final note-only candidate retains identical analyzer inputs; independent reviewer reproduced all four outcomes from the final concrete export.

private_source_retention: All six original snapshots remain byte-identical on disk and excluded from Git. Existing reconciliation and independent review hashes continue to identify those private originals.
rejected_screenshot_scope: Two rejected full-page captures and one mislabeled telemetry capture. The images used by the tour remain publishable. No original image was deleted.

validation.last_note_delta: Only exporter_sha256 changed in all six derivatives; publication_notes additionally changed in the two eventless host-ui2 exports. Evidence fields remain byte-equivalent.
validation.publishable_text_auth_fingerprint_scan: No expected=/received=8-hex pattern in new publishable JSON, JSONL, Markdown, text or HTML.
